The '''Minimum Security Section''' was one of the main districts of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Belsavis prison|complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Devoted to the containment of "low-risk" inmates, primarily [[Human/Legends|Humans]], the section was also the location of the [[Prison Administration Center]] and other facilities that were integral to the prison's functioning.
